blurb: Guests fish for species such as Mangrove Snappers, Sea Trout, Snook, Redfish, Black Drum, Sharks, and Tarpon in the Florida Keys. Trips include life jackets, fishing licenses, rods, reels, bait, tackle, and water. Capt. Bruce and guides are CPR certified and provide filleting of catch.
